title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-11-13
ranking_basis: Daily GitHub Trending star gains for the first 13 entries; one separately identified recent-creation supplement is appended.
ranking_explanation: The first 13 repositories are ordered by the 'stars today' values captured from GitHub Trending on 2026-11-13 at 01:41 UTC. apex-compute/ANR was found via GitHub Search (created 2026-11-11, 982 current stars) and has no daily star-gain value, so it is appended rather than interleaved.
global_caveat: Daily star gains are a short-window popularity signal, not a quality or sustained-adoption measure. Current total stars and default-branch commits were corroborated via GitHub REST API and may move after the snapshot.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time: 2026-11-13 01:41 UTC. Scope: Daily. GitHub Trending window: 2026-11-13 ('Today'); discovery supplement covers 2026-11-11 through 2026-11-13. Ranking is based on daily Trending gains, with one recent-creation supplement.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent-oriented software is the strongest signal today: agent-ready web guidance, engineering workflows, security scanning, and desktop agent workspaces all appear in the leaders. The biggest single gain is Meta’s Astryx design system; a newly created neural-rendering project adds a smaller, separate launch signal.

sections.title: meta/astryx
sections.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
sections.why_notable: The largest daily gain in the captured Trending view and evidence that agent-aware UI tooling is gaining attention.
sections.unique_caveat: The README describes the project as currently in beta.

sections.title: we-promise/sure
sections.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
sections.why_notable: The strongest non-agent consumer application in the daily list, broadening the snapshot beyond AI developer tooling.

sections.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
sections.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
sections.why_notable: Strong momentum for packaged workflows spanning specification, implementation, testing, review, and release.
sections.unique_caveat: The README notes a portability gap: installing a single skill does not copy the repository-level shared references.

sections.title: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
sections.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
sections.why_notable: A high-growth example of delivering curated browser-platform expertise directly to coding agents via a CLI, including legacy-pattern scanning.
sections.unique_caveat: This is the source repository for the separately distributed Modern Web Guidance product.

sections.title: openai/codex-security
sections.description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
sections.why_notable: Security workflows combine scanning, validation, remediation, verification, and CI integrations.
sections.unique_caveat: The README lists supported Node.js and Python version requirements; deployment compatibility should be checked before adoption.

sections.title: Alishahryar1/free-claude-code
sections.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, VSCode, Pi, and OpenCode (and 6 other harnesses) for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone, and now from the browser with native browser sessions (multi-harness + multi-model) like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)
sections.why_notable: Daily momentum reflects interest in a unified surface spanning multiple coding-agent harnesses and models.
sections.unique_caveat: The repository description's free-token and service-availability claims are maintainer claims, not independently verified here.

sections.title: CopilotKit/OpenBot
sections.description: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.
sections.why_notable: Its self-hostable agent workspace emphasizes action planning, recording, and human approval.
sections.unique_caveat: The README labels the business workspace as early access.

sections.title: pookjw/HermesEnabler
sections.description: Enable Hermès Watch Faces on any Apple Watch devices
sections.why_notable: A focused Apple Watch customization project stands out as a non-AI hardware-side spike.

sections.title: ggml-org/llama.cpp

sections.title: QwenLM/qwen-code

sections.why_notable: A terminal coding agent continues to attract attention amid competition over agent ecosystems and workflows.

sections.title: nodejs/node

sections.title: apex-compute/ANR
sections.description: Apex Neural Rendering (ANR) by Apex Compute
sections.why_notable: GitHub Search found this project, created 2026-11-11 and recently pushed, with 982 current stars; it is a separate fresh-creation signal, not a daily Trending gain ranking entry.
sections.unique_caveat: The README says the main renderer source code is coming soon; currently available source includes the nr-record comparison utility.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent-ready engineering knowledge: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src and addyosmani/agent-skills. Agent security and supervised workspaces: openai/codex-security, Alishahryar1/free-claude-code, and CopilotKit/OpenBot. Agent-aware interface systems: meta/astryx. Local inference spans ggml-org/llama.cpp and Zig-based ashhart/TensorFold. Language signal: TypeScript leads with five of the thirteen daily Trending repositories; JavaScript appears in two, while the rest are C++, Shell, Objective-C, Ruby, Python, and Zig. Non-AI projects include personal finance, Apple Watch customization, and foundational runtime/version-management tools.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today’s strongest through-line is the operationalization of coding agents: better domain knowledge, repeatable engineering skills, security review, and computer-use workspaces. Local inference remains represented, and the list is not exclusively AI. One-day star gains measure short-window attention, not software quality or sustained adoption.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: https://github.com/trending?since=daily, captured 2026-11-13 01:41 UTC. Corroboration: GitHub REST repository and default-branch endpoints for all listed repositories; GitHub Search API query created:2026-11-11..2026-11-13 stars:>100 supplied the ANR supplement. Current totals and commit SHAs are API values. Trending gains are values shown in the captured daily view and may differ slightly from later totals. Forks and list-only repositories excluded. No prior-window data was collected; no Notable Shifts section is included.
